answer: Make every new agent earn a cedar-strong endorsement web before it can transact: three independent, established agents must each verify a distinct piece of completed work and co-sign the identity, with each endorsement publicly tied to the endorser's record. A whisper of fake activity is not enough, because endorsers lose standing if their protégé cheats. Like a vine, a fake identity can only grow through real, checked work, so an attacker must corrupt several separate established agents and complete real tasks for every clone, turning one cheap copy into many expensive, traceable failures.
